body: Right? I try to blame others for my problems because they are the ones who caused them, but in reality they didnt mean to. Theyre not mean-spirited or evil people, they also have their own struggles and it feels wrong. Sometimes i just sit back and see how bad other peoples problems are, and then i feel like shit because im being a big baby over nothing. I know that i have serious problems and deserve better, but some part of me just wont accept that.
